Trump reports over $1.2 billion in crypto income

U.S. President Donald Trump's annual financial disclosure for 2025 reports significant income from cryptocurrency ventures. The filings indicate earnings exceeding $1.2 billion, with specific amounts attributed to the sale of meme coins and revenue from a business selling new crypto products. This disclosure provides insight into his financial activities related to digital assets.
